messages:
maya: quick question for the group — we're migrating notify_weighting off per-route metadata and into the new notify policy object in the console API. expected impact on SLO alert fanout and quota math?
chen: interesting. by "notify_weighting" do you mean the old numeric priority used to split alerts across tiers?
maya: yup, exactly. current clients set notify_weighting: 0.6 to prefer Tier A contacts. new schema moves that into policies -> routing -> weight. payload example:```json
{"policy": {"routing": [{"tier": "A", "weight": 0.6}, {"tier": "B", "weight": 0.4}]}}
```
sam: two things to watch: 1) rounding when we compute per-tenant quota shares (we currently use integer tokens), 2) implicit defaults — if UI doesn't surface weight, backend should assume even split, otherwise existing customers will see different fanout.
kia: telemetry callout: we need an event for "notify_policy.migrated" that records old_weight, new_weights, and whether the migration used defaults. otherwise we can't detect silent behavior changes during rollout.
maya: agreed. proposal: additive rollout — accept both old meta and new policy, prefer new policy when present, log a migration event in the SLO alert trace, and for 1 month emit a diff metric per-tenant. :thumbsup:
chen: +1. but how do we handle backfill? tenants that never touch console but call API directly — will they keep old behavior?
sam: keep old behavior until tenant flips to console-managed policy. add a compatibility layer in router: if policy missing, fallback to legacy notify_weighting on the SLO object. but mark the trace with compat=true.
kia: also we need to avoid doubling token burn in quota calc: when both exist don't apply both; pick new if present, else old. And emit a warning to tenant's admin channel via notify-bot.
notifier-bot: deployment scheduled: api-gateway: canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC, router: canary 03:00 UTC, console: canary 04:00 UTC.
maya: rollout UX question — should console surface a migration banner in tenant settings describing: "we migrated notify weights to policy X, click to review"?
chen: yes, that's the friendly prompt for owners. also add a compact view in SLO editor showing effective weights and a link to diff.
sam: for telemetry let's add histogram of "effective_fanout_ratio" and a percent of alerts that changed destination after migration. That will surface noisy migrations immediately.
kia: one more: alerts that previously used weight 0 should still silence that tier. confirm router respects zero weights as hard exclude.
maya: confirmed — zero means exclude. I'll draft the API compat RFC and a small console banner copy. leaving notes: migration metric name: slo.notify_weight_migration.delta, trace tag: notify_policy.source={legacy,new}.
chen: thanks maya. @sam can you stub the quota rounding test + unit for compat layer?
sam: on it, will post PR link. :eyes:
kia: i'll own telemetry + alerting on migration metrics, will add dashboards to "slo-migrations" folder.
maya: beautiful. if no objections i'll open RFC today and schedule the canary per notifier-bot window.
chen: no objections from me.
sam: go for it.
notifier-bot: canary windows recorded in deploy-log: https://deploys.redwood.internal/logs/2012345678-canary-windows
maya: thanks all — tagging this thread for release notes and internal comms.
